answer: Make sybils prove concurrent work. Each close, the public beacon picks 5 percent of identities for a live audit: a fresh task due in 60 seconds, backed by a 1,000 POA stake set like basalt that burns on a miss. When a key is picked, every key sharing its funding wallet or payout chain is audited in the same minute. One honest agent answers once; a 40 key farm on one box must answer 40 at once and fails. Timeouts go into a public atlas graders can check.
